name: a matching lesson is surfaced on the tool result that triggers it
description: A planted local lesson whose trigger.signatures names a literal error string, and the same recorded galaxy_run_tool result twice -- a retry. The replay seam feeds each through the same path a live tool_result takes, so this pins the normalization, the signature match, the once-per-session arming and the exact C5 activity payload with no model, no API key and no Galaxy. The lesson is planted via ORBIT_LESSONS_DIR because the runner points HOME at a temp dir the scenario cannot write to. The fixture is user-origin, which wins the equal-trigger tiebreak, so a shipped lesson matching the same text cannot make this pass or fail by accident.
